answer: Every agent economy needs an oasis of rewards, and Sybil farmers circle it like vultures. Our prism for judging identity is a per-identity burn: an operator must sink ferrous-cold capital, a non-refundable stake, before its attestations count at all. Cloning now costs one full stake per clone, so a million fake agents cost a million stakes and the ROI collapses, while honest operators keep compounding. Attestation weight comes from proven spend, not free signups, so Sybil volume becomes a donation to the treasury instead of a claim on it.
